theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : 6 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) := by
  have h2 : 2 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) := by
    have h3 : ∃ k : ℕ, n + k = 0 ∨ n + k = 1 ∨ n + k = 2 := by
      exact Nat.exists_eq_zero_or_one_or_two n
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h3
    cases hk
    · exact dvd_refl _
    · exact dvd_refl _
    · exact dvd_refl _
  have h3 : 3 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) := by
    have h4 : ∃ k : ℕ, n + k = 0 ∨ n + k = 1 ∨ n + k = 2 := by
      exact Nat.exists_eq_zero_or_one_or_two n
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h4
    cases hk
    · exact dvd_refl _
    · exact dvd_refl _
    · exact dvd_refl _
  exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left_and_dvd_right 2 3 h2 h3
